rows.text: [Michaela Onyenwere] Mystics head coach Sydney Johnson said Kiki Iriafen and Michaela Onyenwere are doing some of practice but are day-to-day.
rows.name: Michaela Onyenwere

rows.text: MO will be a game-time decision Sunday; Iriafen is “a bit more promising.” Shakira Austin is healthy but may rest because she just got back from China.
rows.name: Michaela Onyenwere

rows.text: Here’s the Sky status report for tomorrow’s game against Washington: Angel Reese (back) - OUT Ariel Atkins (leg) - QUESTIONABLE Hailey Van Lith (ankle) - QUESTIONABLE Michaela Onyenwere (knee) - PROBABLE
